defect_class: Extension code acquires an OS resource (child process, socket, timer) whose lifetime outlives the operation that created it, without a session_shutdown disposal path. The lingering handle keeps the Node event loop alive, so non-interactive `pi -p` hangs on exit and interactive sessions leak orphaned processes.

matches.notes: The reported bug. StdioMcpClient spawns the MCP server child; disposal now flows through the McpToolProvider.dispose() contract, called by the registry on unregister/unregisterAll/session_shutdown. Locked by dispose tests in extensions/mcp/registry.test.ts and lifecycle.test.ts.
spawnSync('jj', ...) is synchronous and waits for completion; no lingering handle. Extension also has a session_shutdown handler.
spawn(editor, ..., { stdio: 'inherit' }) is awaited via child 'close' event inside launchExternalEditor; the parent intentionally blocks until the editor exits. No handle outlives the operation.

additional_coverage: All 8 extensions/examples holding long-lived state register session_shutdown handlers (verified by grep for session_shutdown over the same scope). The reusable StdioMcpClient's disposal contract is documented in extensions/mcp/README.md with an explicit pi -p hang warning.
notes: verify-generalize-sweep.sh invoked with explicit artifact path since this repo uses .specs/ instead of specs/.
